transcript: Tonight, my friend Marie and I attended the opening night of Target Margins production of Pericles by Shakespeare. Shout out to our friend Kate who's assistant stage managing. I knew nothing about Pericles going in and it was wild. I looked it up later and found out that there's some dispute over how much of the play Shakespeare actually authored. And I will say it's quite different than a lot of the Shakespeare works that I know. But like a lot of them, it involves royalty storms, plot twists, family drama and high stake situations that make for really great playgrounds for directors, designers and actors. This production has a really quirky aesthetic, particularly with costuming and sound, which contrast the bleakness of the White Baron set. The whole production was quite unexpected, especially for Shakespeare, but the text still shines through and is performed really well by small cast of 7.
